text: Mia Bonta, candidate for California State Assembly District 18, criticized AB 715's rushed handling and pressed its co-authors for changes. The tracker lists her Assembly Floor vote as Aye, and Vote for Peace reports that she ultimately voted for the bill after criticizing its handling. CAIR Action lists her as Preferred for the general election, Vote for Peace rates her an Ally, and AROC Action endorsed her. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club carried its primary endorsement forward into November 2026.

editorial_cleanup.before: Mia Bonta (D), candidate for California State Assembly District 18, has a mixed record on Palestinian justice. On AB 715, the Assembly antisemitism-prevention bill, tracker records show her as a skeptic who pressured co-authors to "clean up" the bill after its late-night passage in September 2025, yet Vote for Peace reports she ultimately voted for it after criticizing its rushed handling; the bill text does not explicitly name IHRA. CAIR Action lists her as "preferred" for the general election, Vote for Peace rates her "Ally" and marks her "supported," AROC Action endorsed her, and the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club endorsed her in the primary, a carry-forward into November 2026.
editorial_cleanup.reason: Report the recorded criticism and Aye vote separately, without inventing a causal sequence or exact timing for the revisions.
